description: Andhra Pradesh is set to transform its education system with the launch of LEAP (Learning Excellence in Andhra Pradesh). This will include new teaching methods, AI tools, curriculum upgrades and classroom infrastructure to improve student learning outcomes starting from the 2025–26 academic year.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh to revamp education system with AI, skill-based learning from 2025 Andhra Pradesh is set to transform its education system with the launch of LEAP (Learning Excellence in Andhra Pradesh). This will include new teaching methods, AI tools, curriculum upgrades and classroom infrastructure to improve student learning outcomes starting from the 2025–26 academic year. Andhra Pradesh is set to overhaul its education system with the launch of LEAP (Learning Excellence in Andhra Pradesh), a comprehensive model aimed at transforming learning outcomes for students across the state.
